meta.description: Report incidents safely in Kraków — anonymously, with human help.

common.simulation: Prototype simulation — no services are contacted.
common.example: Example layout with sample data. Real records appear here in a later phase.
common.comingSoon: Available in a later phase of this prototype.

disclaimer.title: In danger right now? Call 112.
disclaimer.body: Haven is not an emergency service and nobody watches reports in real time. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 112.

home.title: Start with what you have
home.lead: Tell us what happened, in your own words. Save a private draft, add photos or video when you can, and decide later whether to file it.
home.noAccountBody: You can report as a guest. Drafts stay private until you choose to file them. You never have to give your name or contact the police.
home.next1: Your report gets a reference number you can keep.
home.next2: It is routed to the kind of human help it needs — a support service, a volunteer network or the police, only if you agree.
home.next3: You can follow updates in My reports.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Sign in to follow your reports from another device, or to open a staff workspace.
login.placeholder: Sign-in with demo accounts arrives in the next phase.
login.guest: You don't need an account to report.

reportNew.title: Report an incident
reportNew.lead: Take your time. Everything stays a private draft until you choose to file it.
reportNew.whatHint: Write it in your own words. Short is fine.
reportNew.categoryLabel: What kind of incident was it?
reportNew.categoryHint: Not sure? Leave it as Unclassified.

myReports.title: My reports
myReports.lead: Your private drafts and filed reports.
myReports.emptyBody: When you start a report, it appears here as a private draft.

report.title: Report
report.sampleWhat: A group shouted insults at me at the tram stop because of my accent.
report.eventMessage: A caseworker asked whether you'd like a call back.

area.title: Area reports
area.lead: How many incidents were filed in each Kraków district. Exact locations are never shown.
area.notScore: The public map is not a safety score.
area.mapSoon: The district map arrives in a later phase.

settings.title: Account and settings
settings.guest: You are using Haven as a guest.

queue.title: Response queue
queue.lead: Filed reports waiting for an operator decision, most urgent first.
queue.routingBody: Smart Router result and rule appear here.
queue.advisoryBody: A deterministic, rule-based suggestion. It never decides for you.

vault.title: Evidence vault
vault.lead: Photos, video and audio attached to filed reports.
vault.emptyBody: Evidence from filed reports appears here.

cases.title: Assigned cases
cases.emptyBody: Cases sent to your organisation appear here.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subject: Subject
audit.emptyBody: Events are recorded as people use Haven.
